title: Architecture map for Core, Modules, and Plugins
summary: Contributor documentation now names three layers — Core, Modules, and Plugins — and lists where today's code sits. Sign-in, pages, permissions, and addresses behave the same.
changes: Add an architecture decision that names Core, Modules (APES CIC, Pet Care Clinic, Shelter and Rescue), and Plugins (Tickets, Cases, Recruitment, Consultations, Pet Profiles).
Publish an inventory of routes, code, and permissions against those layers, without moving any of them.
Record that existing permission names and web addresses stay as they are until a later change says otherwise.
Point contributor instructions at the architecture docs and the v0.37 structure line.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.36.x: documentation only, with no change to behaviour, URLs, or stored permissions.
validation: php artisan route:list --json was used to build the route inventory.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
No application code, routes, migrations, or permission strings were edited.
known_limitations: The new folder layout is approved for a later change and is not created in this release.
On-screen wording still waits for the glossary. This release does not rename buttons or menus.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. That removes the architecture docs and this change log entry. It does not change accounts, permissions, or addresses, because this release did not change them.
provenance: Architecture decision and inventory for issues #279 and #280, pull request #297.
